The X-ray spectrum depends on the solar wind composition, and is typically dominated by H- or He-like carbon, oxygen, and nitrogen ions. It is impossible to know the precise speed and composition of the solar wind at the both the location of 3I/ATLAS and at the observed epoch. Keep the analysis tractable. Use only the inputs that affect final results to the leading orders.
